༄༅/ /rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang khrus chog shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang khrus chog shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gang gis rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sgom zhing de'i rjes gnang dang khrus chog kyang bya bar 'dod pas/ gnas dben par 'bru tshom lnga pa dang*/ bum pa rgyan ldan nang bcud dang bcas pa bshams shing mtha' mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor gsum bshams/ rnam 'joms yin na rma bya'i sgro yang bshams/ rdor dril sogs 'du byas/ stan bde bar skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang*/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ sarba bidyā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ zhes byin brlabs/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rgyal ba 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ye tiṣṭha/ na mo pu ru ṣya hoḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rang la bsdu| rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhes pa rnams spyir bstan nas/ rnam 'joms byed na rang rig hūm̐ ljang sngon las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhi 'dzum khro gnyer cung zad bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dpa' brtse sgeg 'gying ba'i nyams can 'od 'phro ba/

de'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma las don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ oṃ badzra bi da ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur bstan pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod| |bstod par 'os pa sogs sbyar bas bstod/ thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar gzungs sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus shing thim par dmigs la/ rgya gar skad du/ nas/ rab tu smras so'i bar lan gcig gis lha sngags kyi che ba dran par byas nas gzungs ring dang*/ snying po nye snying rnams ci nus bzla/ mthar/ sdig pa thams cad nas/ rdzogs so'i bar lan gcig bya'o// yang sme ba brtsegs pa bsgom par 'dod na/ sngar gyi gdan la zhes pa yan 'dra la/ hūm̐ ljang nag 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa dbus zhal dang sku mdog ljang nag /g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba'i zhal gsum spyan dgu dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ mche ba bcu gnyis gtsigs shing smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom ral pa'i tshogs dmar ser gyen du 'phyo ba/ zhabs gnyis bgrad cing yan lag thams cad sprul gyis brgyan pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol ba/ g.yas gnyis pa gser gyi rdo rje/ gsum pa lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis pa dril bu/ gsum pas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i klong na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar zhes pa nas/ rang nyid la thim par bsam ba'i bar rnam 'joms ltar bya/ oṃ ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapad sbyar bas mchod/ hūm̐ */ sme ba'i rigs la khro bo che// zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku// yan lag gdug pa klu yis brgyan// grib 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa sogs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ ljang nag gi mthar sngags phreng gis g.yas su bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ nyams grib la sogs pa mi gtsang ba thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim par bsam nas/ oṃ bhurkuṃ ma hā pra ma nā ya bhurtsi bhurki bi ma la u tstshuṣma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badzra bhurkuṃ ri li shu tharsha turshe bi ma le u tstshuṣma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'/ zhes ci nus bzla bar bya'o| |'di gnyis kyi rjes gnang bya ba ni/ mdun gyi maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇḍal gyi dbus su sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhes pa nas lha gang yin gyi mngon rtogs bsgyur zhing*/ dbang gi lha rang nyid la bstim pa'i bar dang*/ lha gang yin gyi mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i bum pa bcud kyis gang ba'i dbus su sna tshogs padma nas mchod bstod kyi bar lha gang yin sbyar/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros gzung thag la brgyud bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la phog /de las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar dmigs/ sngags ci grub bzla/ las bum la 'khyil pa nyer gcig sogs bzla/ bum pa'i lha zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du bsam/

bum mdun thun mong du gtor ma byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas nas| lha gang yin gyi nye snying gi mthar/ a kā ro gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ 'dod don gsol/ bdag 'jug slob ma rjes 'dzin ltar blangs/ slob ma khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad/ mdun du 'khod pas maṇḍal phul/ lo rgyus skabs sbyar bshad nas dbang gi don du/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ni/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar lha gang byed kyi mngon rtogs bsgyur bar sbyar/ des lus sgrib sbyangs/ sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas ba sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nyid brtan phyir slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dbang gi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags bcas gsung zhing dbang bskur bar dmigs/ bum dbang bskur/ bum pa'i chus sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma las don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang lha slob ma la bstims/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng spros/ zhal nas thon slob ma'i rna ba g.yas par zhugs par bsam la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos gsum bya/ rnam 'joms yin na lha sngags kyi che ba dran par slob dpon gyis tshar gcig brjod/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// brjod/ bla mas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// su pra tiṣṭha badzra dang me tog dor/

des ngag sgrib sbyangs/ sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas pa gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las lha rang 'dra ba spros pa slob ma'i smin mtshams su thim par dmigs/ ting nge 'dzin dar cig sgom/ des yid sgrib dag /ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// 'dir sgam po pas gtor dbang byed ba rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mthun shas chung bas dpyad/ dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul lo/// / ༈ /khrus chog byed na/ lha 'di gnyis khrus chog gi lugs so sor 'byung bas cho ga dkyus gcig tu byas na mi 'thad pas/ thog mar rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog byed na/ mdun bskyed mi dgos/ bdag bum gtor 'bul yan grub rjes/ gdan dkar nag gnyis bting ba'i nag po'i steng du slob ma bzhag /chu gtsang gis khrus byas la/ skabs 'dir bgegs dang sdig pa sbyong ba'i tshul rab gnas ltar byed pa sgam po spyan sngas gsungs pa ltar spro na bya/ mi spro na med mi rung ba min pas mi dgos/ bsgrub bya'i mdun du khrus rten ngar mi/ ting lo/ chang bu/ ong skyu dang bcas pa bzhag /dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa gsal ba'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba bsnams pa bsgrub bya'i spyi bor sbreng zhing*/ khrus byas pas sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud sol gyi khu ba ltar byung ba khrus gdan la thim par bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ rgya gar skad du/ nas/ smras so'i bar tshar gcig brjod/ bum chus bkru zhing yang snying gi mthar sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sarba bighnāṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba ro ṣa shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

sarba duṣṭāṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba dzwa re shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba u pa dra bya shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba gra ha shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba dursopta shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba durmi ti shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sarba tsitta bhyaḥku la shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rdo rje slob ma'i sdig pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /bgegs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /grib thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /rims thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /yams thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /dus min 'chi ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /ltas ngan thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /sems kyi rnam g.yeng thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /ces bkrus/ byab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag na rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su margata'i kha dog lta bu'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus te byab pas khrus gdan la thim par bsam/ gong gi sngags mthar a pa na ya swā hā dang*/ tshig mthar byang bar gyur cig sbyar la rma bya'i sgros byab/ khrus chu ngar glud dang bcas sngags tshig gis bgegs la bsngos la lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal/ bsrung ba ni/ mdun mkha'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gnas rnams nas rdo rje rgya gram dpag tu med pa spros/ bsgrub bya'i gnas rnams su thim pas lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lub tu gyur pas gdon bgegs thams cad kyis blags mi rnyed par bsam/ bsgrub bya'i gnas rnams su rdo rje rgya gram gtug cing sngags mthar rakṣa swā hā/ tshig mthar srungs shig sbyar/ khrus sa nas dbyung ba ni/ gdan nag po 'khor ba'i gnas nyam nga ba las thar te/ gdan dkar po thar pa'i gnas yid du 'ong bar phyin par bsam zhing bsgrub bya thal mo sbyar bas slob dpon gyi rdo rje la 'jus te gdan dkar po'i steng du 'khod/

sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /zhes sogs nas/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /yan rjes zlos tshar gcig bya/ rjes su slob dpon gyis bsgrub bya la me tog dor zhing shis brjod skabs sbyar bya ba dag go/// / ༈ /yang sme brtsegs kyi khrus chog byed na mdun bskyed mi dgos/ bdag bum gtor 'bul sogs gong ltar grub rjes/ bsgrub bya chu gtsang gis bkrus la chu de logs su bzhag /srin lag bzhi skud pa nag pos bcings la mdun du 'khod pa la bum pa'i chu khro bo zhu ba'i rang bzhin gyis bkrus par bsam la/ ji ltar bltams pa'i mthar/ rtsa sngags btags pa'i mjug tu/ chai ge mo'i nyams grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sde 'khrug thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ khrims nyams thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ dam grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ nal grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ yug grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ ro grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mdze grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ dme grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ nad grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ gdon grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ gos grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ gnas grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zas grib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de nas sbyang ba ni/ zhi ba la chang bu dang mtheb skyu sbrags pa res g.yas su lan re bskor zhing*/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e hoḥshuddhe shuddhe/ yaṃ hoḥshuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ hoḥshuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ hoḥshuddhe shuddhe/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe aḥ.aḥswā hā/ zhes lan re brjod cing bskor nas sngar chu gtsang gis dri ma bkrus pa logs su bzhag pa der blug

/de 'dra ba lan nyer gcig bya'o// de nas chang bu khrus chu sogs lam bzhi mdor bskyal/ phyi mig mi blta/ drag pos sbyang ba ni/ bsgrub bya la yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug /khro bo'i sngags drag tu bzlas la brdeg go// de nas grib lhag ma thams cad srin lag gi skud pa la thim par bsam la khro bo'i sngags dang*/ grib sbyong 'byung ba'i sngags bzla zhing gris bcad la gtor chung gcig dang mnyam du gnod pa'i phyogs su bskyal lo// tshul de 'dra ba rab lan gcig gis grib byang ba'i mtshan ma 'byung*| 'bring lnga'am bdun/ tha ma nyer gcig byas na mi phan pa mi srid do// yul khams kyi grib sbyong na lung pa de'i 'bab chu'am/ chu mig gam/ khron pa sogs la khro bo bskyed cing grib sbyong lag len ltar byas pas 'grub bo// skabs gzhan du lha 'di gnyis ka'i bum pa sogs bca' pa ma grub kyang*/ rgyun 'bab kyi chu sogs la lhar bskyed cing sngags bzla ba sogs byas nas khrus bya ba'am/ de tsam yang ma grub na sngags kho na bzlas nas khrus byas na phan yon shin tu che'o// tshul 'di gnyis kyi rnam 'joms ni nad gdon grib thams cad la bsngags pa yin la/ sme brtsegs ni dam nyams kyi grib dang sde 'khrug gi grib sogs mang po'i gnyan po ste/ sde 'khrug ni dge 'dun 'khrug pa la zer zhes jo bo rjes gsungs la/ de byas pa'i shul du sa tshig pa zhes yi dam gyi lha sogs mi lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byin par gsungs pas de 'dra'i nyes pa sbyong ba sogs dgos pa gal che mang ba'i phyir rtsod dus deng sang gi dus nyams su blang byar mthong ngo*// sme brtsegs la las mtha' phran bu khag mang du mchis kyang deng sang lag len du byed pa nyung bas ma bris so// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ shis brjod/ bsngo smon sogs spyi 'gro ltar byas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar rnam 'joms ni ba ri lo tsā ba'i lugs dang*/

sme brtsegs ni jo bo rje'i rjes su 'brangs nas shin tu bsdus par bkod pa yin no// smras pa/ rgyud dang paṇa grub dgongs pa dang*// mthun na bsdus kyang legs bshad nyid// bka' dang bstan bcos dang 'gal na// tshig don mang yang ltar snang chos// de phyir blo dman la phan phyir// mdor bsdus bshad mod 'gal ba ci// rnam par ma brtag gya tshom chos// grang ba'i nad la ga pur bzhin// nyon mongs gnyen po'ang de grogs su// song bas dad ldan bslus pa mang*// 'di dge zla ba ltar dkar ba// 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// zhes rdo rje rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs/ dbang bskur/ khrus chog tshig nyung don tshang shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang long po bkra shis bde chen gyi sgrub sde'i bla ma phun tshogs 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa gsang sngags kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ me khams byi ba lo nag pa zla ba'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa dang po la dpal 'bri gung du bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang*/ phyag rdor/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ rtse mo/ bsod dbang*/ bla ma rin dpal/ bla ma byang gzhon/ mkhan chen byang seng*/ chos rje ye rgyan/ kun dga' bzang po/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ buddha ratna/ spyan snga ngag dbang*/ bla ma ratna shrī/ drin chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag dharma kīrti la stsal ba'o// sme brtse gas jo bo rje'i lugs kyi rgyud pa ni/ kṛ ya dpung bzang gi rgyud nas jo bo rje a ti shas legs par bsdus te bod du bsnams/ de nas rim gyis nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor/ bya 'dul/ chos byang chub/ zul phu ba/ dkon seng*/ de gnyis la tshul rin pas/ bla ma dar bzang*/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan don grub| gtsang pa rin rgyal/ bya btang byang chub/

'jam dbyangs rin chen grags/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ ngag dbang chos grags/ chos rje byams pa dpal/ bla ma ratna shrī/ yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bdag dharma kirti la stsal ba'o// tshul 'di'i legs byas chu klung gis// 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal 'byin shog/ //sarba madga laṃ//
